translations.web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
translations.bsb: The wicked man earns an empty wage, but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
translations.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
translations.asv: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.
